name: reg-triage
description: Regulatory Intelligence Triage Pipeline — Full-stack application for managing regulatory compliance updates

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w packages/server" "npm run dev -w packages/web"
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w packages/server && npm run build -w packages/web
